CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_user_can_manage_users()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.users as u
    where u.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
      and u.is_active = true
      and u.role = 'admin'
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dashboard_user_can_manage_personal_reports()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT private.dashboard_user_can_access_personal_reports()
    AND (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.profiles
        WHERE id = auth.uid()
          AND role = 'admin'
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.users u
        WHERE u.auth_user_id = auth.uid()
          AND u.is_active = true
          AND lower(trim(coalesce(u.permissions->>'personal_reports_manager', ''))) IN ('yes', 'true', '1')
      )
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.av2_sync_generated_cancellation_date()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.generation_kind is null and old.report_date is distinct from new.report_date then
    perform set_config('app.av2_compensation_write', '1', true);
    update public.attendance_records child
    set report_date = new.report_date, updated_at = now()
    where child.source_attendance_record_id = new.id
      and child.generation_kind = 'travel_time_cancellation';
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

functions.name: public.av2_block_manual_cancellation_when_system_path
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.av2_block_manual_cancellation_when_system_path()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT'
     and new.generation_kind is null
     and new.activity_type = 'ביטול זמן'
     and public.av2_day_has_system_travel_path(new.emp_id, new.report_date)
  then
    raise exception 'attendance_manual_cancellation_blocked_system_travel_path'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: public.av2_guard_base_training_attendance
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.av2_guard_base_training_attendance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_is_base_training boolean;
begin
  v_is_base_training :=
    trim(coalesce(new.activity_name_snapshot, '')) = 'הכשרת בסיס'
    or trim(coalesce(new.program_name_snapshot, '')) = 'הכשרת בסיס'
    or trim(coalesce(new.program_name, '')) = 'הכשרת בסיס';

  if v_is_base_training
     and (
       new.report_date is null
       or new.report_date < date '2026-09-15'
       or new.report_date > date '2026-09-17'
     )
  then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '23514',
      message = 'base_training_date_not_allowed',
      detail = 'Base training attendance is restricted to 2026-09-15 through 2026-09-17.';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: public.av2_mark_daily_travel_after_attendance_delete
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.av2_mark_daily_travel_after_attendance_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.generation_kind IS NOT NULL
     OR OLD.report_date < DATE '2026-11-01'
     OR OLD.activity_type IN ('זום','ביטול זמן')
     OR COALESCE(OLD.training_mode::text,'physical')='online'
     OR COALESCE(OLD.operation_meeting_mode,'physical')='online'
  THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;

  -- The existing attendance-change trigger first retracts approved travel.
  -- Keep an audit trace of deletion, but never keep the obsolete trip in reports.
  INSERT INTO public.attendance_daily_travel_audit (
    emp_id,travel_date,previous_status,previous_approved_km,
    previous_approved_cancellation_minutes,
    previous_approved_public_transport_cost,reason,actor
  )
  SELECT d.emp_id,d.travel_date,d.review_status,d.approved_km,
    d.approved_cancellation_minutes,d.approved_public_transport_cost,
    'attendance_deleted_travel_removed',auth.uid()
  FROM public.attendance_daily_travel_reports d
  WHERE d.emp_id=OLD.emp_id AND d.travel_date=OLD.report_date;

  DELETE FROM public.attendance_daily_travel_reports d
  WHERE d.emp_id=OLD.emp_id AND d.travel_date=OLD.report_date;

  PERFORM set_config('app.av2_compensation_write','1',true);

  -- Prevent an orphaned day-level approved payable from being counted in wages.
  DELETE FROM public.attendance_records a
  WHERE a.emp_id=OLD.emp_id AND a.report_date=OLD.report_date
    AND a.generation_kind='daily_travel_cancellation';

  -- Pre-cutover manual cancellation rows surviving into November are also
  -- day-level compensation, and must not outlive the changed travel day.
  DELETE FROM public.attendance_records a
  WHERE a.emp_id=OLD.emp_id AND a.report_date=OLD.report_date
    AND a.generation_kind IS NULL AND a.activity_type='ביטול זמן';

  RETURN OLD;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.av2_invalidate_daily_travel_after_activity_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_emp bigint;v_date date;v_old public.attendance_daily_travel_reports%rowtype;
begin
  if tg_op='UPDATE' and old.generation_kind is null and new.generation_kind is null
    and old.report_date is not distinct from new.report_date
    and old.start_time is not distinct from new.start_time
    and old.end_time is not distinct from new.end_time
    and old.activity_type is not distinct from new.activity_type
    and old.school_id is not distinct from new.school_id
    and old.school_name_snapshot is not distinct from new.school_name_snapshot
    and old.destination_address_snapshot is not distinct from new.destination_address_snapshot
    and old.training_mode is not distinct from new.training_mode
    and old.operation_meeting_mode is not distinct from new.operation_meeting_mode
  then return new; end if;
  if tg_op='INSERT' and new.generation_kind is not null then return new; end if;
  if tg_op='DELETE' and old.generation_kind is not null then return old; end if;
  if tg_op='UPDATE' and (old.generation_kind is not null or new.generation_kind is not null)
    then return new; end if;

  for v_emp,v_date in
    select distinct x.emp,x.travel_day from (
      select case when tg_op<>'INSERT' then old.emp_id else null end emp,
             case when tg_op<>'INSERT' then old.report_date else null end travel_day
      union all
      select case when tg_op<>'DELETE' then new.emp_id else null end,
             case when tg_op<>'DELETE' then new.report_date else null end
    ) x where x.emp is not null and x.travel_day >= date '2026-11-01'
  loop
    select * into v_old from public.attendance_daily_travel_reports
      where emp_id=v_emp and travel_date=v_date
        and review_status in ('approved','corrected')
      for update;
    if found then
      insert into public.attendance_daily_travel_audit(
        emp_id,travel_date,previous_status,previous_approved_km,
        previous_approved_cancellation_minutes,previous_approved_public_transport_cost,reason,actor)
      values(v_emp,v_date,v_old.review_status,v_old.approved_km,
        v_old.approved_cancellation_minutes,v_old.approved_public_transport_cost,'activity_changed',auth.uid());
      update public.attendance_daily_travel_reports
      set review_status='pending_review',approved_km=null,
        approved_cancellation_minutes=null,approved_public_transport_cost=null,review_by=null,review_at=null,updated_at=now()
      where id=v_old.id;
      perform set_config('app.av2_compensation_write','1',true);
      delete from public.attendance_records
      where emp_id=v_emp and report_date=v_date
        and generation_kind='daily_travel_cancellation';
    end if;
  end loop;
  return case when tg_op='DELETE' then old else new end;
end $function$

functions.name: public.av2_attendance_month_is_closed
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.av2_attendance_month_is_closed(p_emp_id bigint, p_report_date date)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    exists (
      select 1
      from public.attendance_month_approvals ama
      where ama.emp_id = p_emp_id
        and ama.month_key = to_char(p_report_date, 'YYYY-MM')
        and ama.status = 'locked'
    )
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.payroll_control_approvals pca
      where pca.employee_id = p_emp_id::text
        and pca.month_key = to_char(p_report_date, 'YYYY-MM')
        and pca.status = 'approved_for_payroll'
    );
$function$

functions.name: attendance_private.course_work
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION attendance_private.course_work(sources jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH windows AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT extract(epoch from (item->>'start_time')::time)::int/60 s,
      extract(epoch from (item->>'end_time')::time)::int/60 e
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(sources) item
  ), ordered AS (
    SELECT *, max(e) OVER (ORDER BY s,e ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) prior_end FROM windows
  ), clustered AS (
    SELECT *, sum(CASE WHEN prior_end IS NULL OR s >= prior_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY s,e) cluster FROM ordered
  ), sessions AS (SELECT min(s) s,max(e) e FROM clustered GROUP BY cluster),
  paid AS (
    SELECT s,e,
      CASE WHEN e-s=45 THEN 60 WHEN e-s BETWEEN 80 AND 120 THEN 120 ELSE e-s END paid_minutes
    FROM sessions
  )
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM windows WHERE s IS NULL OR e IS NULL OR e<=s)
    AND count(*)>0 THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'start_time',to_char(time '00:00'+make_interval(mins=>min(s)),'HH24:MI'),
      'end_time',to_char(time '00:00'+make_interval(mins=>max(e)),'HH24:MI'),
      'paid_minutes',sum(paid_minutes),'total_hours',round(sum(paid_minutes)::numeric/60,2)
    ) ELSE NULL END FROM paid;
$function$
